title: Display funeral prices
what: As a funeral director, prominently display the funeral information (including prices and a basic package estimate) at each place of business and on its website.

laws.title: Fair Trading (Funeral Pricing Code of Practice) Regulations 2022 (WA)

sources.quote: A funeral director must prominently display the funeral information in relation to the supply of goods and services by the funeral director — (a) at each place of business of the funeral director; and (b) on a website of the funeral director
